bolivar-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Created in 1902 and named after Simón Bolívar, who freed much of South America from Spanish rule, Bolívar is rolled at the Partagás factory in central Havana from Vuelta Abajo wrapper and filler. Full in strength and favoured by experienced smokers, it pairs creamy cocoa with wood and pepper, adding dried fruit and nuts as it burns.

thirds.notes: Cream and cocoa on a woody base, with pepper, coffee and touches of dried fruit and malt.
Wood, fruit and spice weave together over earth and nuts, bold yet steady.
The profile holds its course to a long finish, though some smokers find the strength climbs here.

bolivar-cuba--edicion-limitada.description: Bolívar's Ediciones Limitadas come in sizes the regular range does not offer, rolled from leaf aged at least two years and marked by a black and gold seal and an extra band with the year. The Soberano of 2018 brought the 54 x 140 mm size to the brand for the first time, with a balanced, aromatic blend; the Regentes, 52 x 130 mm, followed in 2021.
